## Clear alerts with retryable delivery
Configure Header Auth: x-releaseguard-alert = ALERT_TOKEN. The controller uses a transactional outbox, retries failures, and sends eventId for deduplication.
This receiver demonstrates validated alert formatting. Add your Slack/Teams/email node after Format operational alert and before Return response. Deduplicate eventId at your sink. ReleaseGuard considers a 2xx response accepted by this receiver, not read by a person.
CI uses only this local receiver; no messages are sent to external people.
